newsitem.title: USA: CME June S&P 500s rally to seven-pt opening limit.
newsitem.headline: CME June S&P 500s rally to seven-pt opening limit.

text.p: CME June Standard & Poor's 500 futures rallied to the seven-point opening limit on follow-through buying from GLOBEX, traders said.
June S&Ps gradually climbed up seven points to 844.85.

Pit trade was halted for two minutes since June S&Ps were locked at the limit after 10 minutes of trade. When the market re-opened June immediately shot to 846.30, an all-time high, on light dealer buying, they said.
There are no upside limits for the rest of the day.

On GLOBEX, June S&Ps rose 6.50 points to 844.35 in sympathy with the U.S. bond market. U.S. bond prices rose, while yields fell, due to lower-than-expected U.S. producer prices for April. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
